title: Minimize Malware Spread II
goal: Choose one infected node to remove with all its edges to minimize the final malware spread.
strategy: Union only initially clean nodes. A clean component is saved by removing an infected source only when that source is its sole infected neighbor. Sum those uniquely exposed component sizes per candidate.
